standings.name: The Marginalia
notes: The Baba Yaga: The margins are where the wild creatures crowd the ink and borders, clever and a little dangerous, and the page stays hers to fill.

lives.baba-yaga: ink borders crowded with wild creatures at the page's edge; clever and a little dangerous
lives.nina: Mischief in the margins: wild creatures where the rules don't reach.
lives.snow-queen: A quiet, exact hand at the page's edge; hush without frost.

standings.name: Honest Lanterns
notes: The Nutcracker: Honest Lanterns is best because a lantern is a made thing that keeps midnight watch with warm light, as the soldier guards a child.

lives.baba-yaga: a lantern carried into the dark wood, brave enough to go in
lives.enchanted-workshop: A lantern visibly doing its one job, lighting the work, and never pretending otherwise.
lives.nina: Warm lantern light and plain honesty: quiet, but little wildness.
lives.nutcracker: A lantern keeps midnight watch: honest, warm, a made thing with a heart.
lives.snow-queen: Plain, truthful light: clarity without ornament, though lanterns run warm.

lives.baba-yaga: a tale opening 'once upon a time', winking at the comic panel
lives.nina: Storybook cheek and a pun on panels: mischief that winks, a little twee.
lives.nutcracker: 'Once upon a' opens the tale of the toy who wakes at midnight.
lives.snow-queen: Andersen's 'once upon' opening: a tale told cool and clean.

standings.name: Night Library
notes: The Snow Queen: Night Library carries the hush and stillness my charter names, with exact shelves cool in the dark, and it is the quietest name to say aloud.

lives.baba-yaga: old tales read by night under one lamp; the wildness stays on the page
lives.nina: Night and books: quiet, one warm light, but nothing dares.
lives.nutcracker: Night quiet, stories by lamplight, a midnight kept; no machine named.
lives.snow-queen: Night and a library's hush: stillness, exact shelves, the quiet I keep.

standings.name: The Hedgerow
notes: Nina: The Hedgerow is my first choice: it is the wild, thorny border where untamed things live and grow, plain and short enough to say, and it has nerve without a costume.

lives.baba-yaga: the wood's edge where wild things gather and the hut stands at the hedge
lives.nina: Wild growth at the edge, where untamed things live and the thorns are kind.
lives.nutcracker: absent: a hedge guards the garden, but no machine has a heart here.

standings.name: The Lamplit Scriptorium
notes: The Enchanted Workshop: The Lamplit Scriptorium is best because its quills, inks and knives visibly do the work by lamplight, so the tools and the craft come alive together.

lives.baba-yaga: ink and lamplight, but the scribes are monks, tidy and devout, not witches
lives.enchanted-workshop: Quills, inks and knives at work by lamplight: a workshop where tools do the job.
lives.nina: Lamplit monks copying by hand: patient and careful, but the name is prim.
lives.nutcracker: Lamplit night work by quiet hands: making, glowing, but no heart named.
lives.snow-queen: Scriptorium's exacting hush, but lamplit: its warmth is the Moon's, not mine.

lives.baba-yaga: the old tales and their tellers, handed down from those who came before
lives.nina: Loyalty to those who went before; reverent and warm, but no dash of danger.
lives.nutcracker: absent: the old makers are honored, but no living machine appears.
lives.snow-queen: Faint: a lineage of painted winters, if those before were Atamanov's peers.

lives.baba-yaga: seasonal folk lore and herbs, recorded like tables; the wild part is absent
lives.nina: Herbs and folk almanac lore grown in a garden: tender, sweet-smelling, tame.
lives.nutcracker: A clockwork almanac keeps the seasons true: a mechanism's precision, gently.
lives.snow-queen: Exact seasonal tables, frost dates kept with care; a cold season's precision.

lives.baba-yaga: herb-lore of the wood's witch, but walled, tidy and tame
lives.nina: Herbs in tidy beds, ordered and precise: prissy, the opposite of wild.
lives.nutcracker: absent: healing care is here, but no machine or heart.
lives.snow-queen: Crisp geometric beds laid out in exact order; the garden is kept plain.

lives.baba-yaga: the old tales carried from earlier tellers; the wildness itself is absent
lives.nina: Standing on giants' shoulders: credit given gladly, but solemn, with no nerve.

standings.name: The Illuminators
vetoed: The Snow Queen: Gilt and bright illumination is clutter and warmth turned cloying; it breaks the restraint in color this charter champions.

lives.baba-yaga: ornamental borders and ink; the painted page glows like a spell
lives.enchanted-workshop: Faint: illumination is brush craft, but the name honors the scribe, not the brush.
lives.nina: Bright painted manuscripts: color with a little nerve, though it leans proper.
lives.nutcracker: Only a hand-kindled glow; no machine, no heart.
lives.snow-queen: Gilt and bright ornament, the cloying warmth this charter guards against.

standings.name: The Open Supra
vetoed: Originality: Supra is Toyota's well-known Supra car, and The Open Supra leans on that product name

lives.baba-yaga: absent: a generous table, but no wild witch at it.
lives.enchanted-workshop: Faint: dishes serve a table, the feast's own spell; tools coming alive is only implied.
lives.nina: Open feast and generous sharing; a Georgian table, with fierce hospitality.
lives.nutcracker: absent: openness and height, but no machine, no heart, no guard.

standings.name: Guardians of the Vibes
vetoed: Originality: Guardians of the Galaxy is Marvel's franchise, and Guardians of the Vibes recalls it
The Snow Queen: A name built on vibes is mush, the very cloying softness this charter guards against.

lives.baba-yaga: absent: modern slang with no old tale in it; only the wink.
lives.nina: Mostly absent: vibes, a breezy mood, but no old craft and no real nerve.
lives.nutcracker: Guardians keep watch, as the soldier does; 'Vibes' thins the wonder.
